PHASE.NAME: UPGRADE_3 Performance Regression
PHASE.GOAL: Add baseline-based performance regression checks for index, search, verify, and graph query workflows.

DATA_FLOWS.FLOW: Perf command runs benchmark set on a MultiModule fixture and stores or compares platform-aware baselines.

STEPS.step-1: Implement benchmark result model, statistics, warmup, and binary invocation helper.
STEPS.step-2: Implement baseline save and threshold comparison with platform metadata.

RISKS.RISK: CI latency noise can create false failures without warmup, platform metadata, and conservative thresholds.
